form_analysis.feedback: Practical eyelash extension aftercare form with essential maintenance instructions. Covers key areas like oil avoidance, proper cleansing, and daily care techniques. Could be enhanced with more detail on expected retention, specific product recommendations, and emergency protocols for adverse reactions.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice is essential to help reduce the risk of treatment complications, to improve your comfort/healing and to help achieve the best possible results from treatment.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow the aftercare advice for eyelash extension treatment.

sections.title: Product Avoidance
sections.content: Avoid cosmetics such as eyeliner, mascara, skincare products, cleansers, and makeup removers that are oil based coming into contact with the extensions.

sections.title: Water Exposure Restriction
sections.content: Avoid getting the extensions wet for 48 hours.

sections.title: Mechanical Care
items: Do not rub or pull at the extensions.
Do not use an eyelash curler.
Do not sleep on your face.

sections.title: Makeup Application and Removal
items: Be careful when applying eye makeup and use cotton swabs or pads to gently remove your eye makeup.
When removing eyeliner, use a cotton swab with water-based makeup remover.

sections.title: Environmental Restrictions
items: Avoid steam rooms, saunas, or sunbeds for 48 hours.
Keep lashes away from direct heat.

sections.title: Cleansing Protocol
sections.content: Wash the lashes gently with a daily eyelash cleanser.

sections.title: Side Effects and Maintenance
items: Contact your practitioner as soon as possible if you notice any side effects.

You may require an infill (top up appointment) at 2-3 weeks, be guided by your practitioner. If you are advised to attend a follow up appointment, please do make every effort to attend them. You should do this even if you believe that the recovery process is going well and you cannot see that there are any visible complications.

patient_declaration.reading_confirmation: It is essential that you have read all of the information available. Once you have read and understood all of the below, please sign the declaration at the bottom of this form.
patient_declaration.question_opportunity: Please do let your practitioner know if you have any questions or if you do not understand any of the aftercare instructions provided below.
patient_declaration.declaration_text: I confirm that I have read and understood all the information on this Form and that I have been given the opportunity to ask any questions that have come to mind throughout.
